snippet.title: Primal Carnage: Evolution | Sandbox Teaser
snippet.description:
Sometimes, you just wanna chill and not wreak carnage. Sandbox is a fun freeroam experience with bonus playable dinosaurs, discoverable cheats, and experimental features such as spawnable bots.

Primal Carnage: Evolution coming MAY 28TH to PlayStation!
